card: Commanded the 3rd Algerian Infantry Division from March 1943.
Took the Belvedere ridge and crossed the Aurunci mountains in Italy, 1944.
His division took part in the capture of Toulon and took Marseille, August 1944.
Led the French II Corps across the Rhine to Stuttgart.
Commanded the 7th Moroccan Tirailleur Regiment in Tunisia, 1942-43.
Chief of staff to Juin in the Italian campaign, 1943.
Led the 2nd Moroccan Infantry Division into Germany, 1944-45.
Chief of staff of the 10th Army Corps; captured by the Germans in 1940.
Imprisoned in 1941 on suspicion of opposing Vichy.
Met General Mark Clark at Cherchell to prepare the Allied landings, October 1942.
Resident General in Tunisia from May 1943.
Commanded the cruiser Georges Leygues from January 1943.
Intercepted the German blockade runner Portland, April 1943.
His IV Cruiser Division bombarded Port-en-Bessin on D-Day.
Led the Flank Force along the Italian coast after the Provence landings.
